What if you got a robot butler for Christmas? Shiny. Polite. A little too helpful.
Hello, family. I am here to help.
Day one. Mom asks it to decorate the tree. It decorates the tree... the sofa... and Dad.
Day two. It bakes cookies. One cookie. Then ten thousand cookies.
Day three. You ask it to shovel the snow. It shovels all the snow... onto the neighbor's house.
Christmas Eve. It wraps every present. Then it wraps itself.
And that's why you never get a robot butler for Christmas.
